(a) the seasonal climate of many tropical regions is predictable from antecedent circulation departures, and (b), the El Nino-Southern Oscillation phenomenon has been shown to be predictable from numerical models of the tropical ocean-atmosphere system.
the climate of the tropical belt has been found to be highly predictable on interannual timescales.
